description: Use when a founder (especially a one-person company / 一人公司) wants to validate an AI product idea or MVP (AI 工具、AI 应用、Agent) before building further, writing a BP, or applying for policy support or investment. Combines desk research and user interviews with Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad tests on a landing page or waitlist, checks AI-specific risks (model-native overlap, inference cost, compliance), and gives a continue/adjust/stop conclusion that feeds the BP.
